svg.title: A client who is receiving end-of-life care in the hospital tells the nurse, 'I am afraid of dying alone.' Which actions should the nurse take? (Select all that apply.)
svg.desc: Frequent contact, proximity to staff, and keeping the client informed all reduce the fear of abandonment that dying clients commonly describe. Limiting conversation and restricting visitors increase isolation, which is exactly the fear the client expressed.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Fear of Dying Alone
Read the situation
A client who is receiving end-of-life care
in the hospital tells the nurse, 'I am
afraid of dying alone.' Which actions
should the nurse take? (Select all that
apply.)
What fits here
Check on the client frequently rather than
only when called · Let the client know
when procedures and assessments will occur
Why it fits
Frequent contact, proximity to staff, and
keeping the client informed all reduce the
fear of abandonment that dying clients
commonly describe. Limiting conversation
and restricting visitors increase
isolation, which is exactly the fear the
client expressed.
